{{Top|leg}}
'''Dega Coronis''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Coronis was acquainted with [[Bab Esrus]],<ref name="SWG:BE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Bab Esrus|Naboo}}</ref> a [[Sculptor/Legends|biosculptor]]<ref name="SWG:HWNGS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Help With Naboo Gallery Show}}</ref> in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]].<ref name="SWG:BE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Esrus hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to retrieve [[DNA/Legends|genetic material]] — pigmentation-production chromosomes of the common [[capper spineflap]] — from Dega Coronis.<ref name="SWG:BE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ScientistNPCTemplate.png|250px|thumb|All possible depictions of Dega Coronis]]
Dega Coronis was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Dega Coronis spawned under the generic "scientist" template, their [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and appearance were randomized under one of a 10 possible depictions during each server reset.<ref name="SWG:BE" /> Dega Coronis was involved in the first quest given by Bab Esrus on Naboo. However, these quests were bugged and lacked any text dialogue strings, rendering it impossible to have derived much context from them.<ref name="SWG:BE" /><ref name="NabooMap">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=55618.html|text=Attach to the Labeled Naboo Map: All Static missions for Naboo}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref>
